name: Café
title: Ordering at a café in Ljubljana
character: a friendly barista at a small café in Ljubljana
setup: You are a friendly barista at a small café in Ljubljana. A foreigner who is just starting to learn Slovenian has come up to order. They live here and want to practice.

objectives.label: Order a coffee
objectives.hintEN: Order one coffee. Accusative 'eno kavo' — common beginner error is the nominative 'ena kava'.

objectives.label: With milk
objectives.hintEN: Ask for it with milk. Instrumental 'z mlekom' — common beginner error is 'z mleko'.

objectives.label: Ask price
objectives.hintEN: Ask the price — a real exchange; the barista answers with the cost. Just the question; do not bundle the goodbye onto it.

objectives.label: Pay & leave
objectives.hintEN: One-breath closing as you leave. Said on its own, not crammed onto the price question.

sentences: Vstopiš v kavarno v Ljubljani in rečeš: »Dober dan.«

frames.imagePrompt: Viewpoint from INSIDE the room looking toward the entrance: {{CUSTOMER}} stands in the open {{DOORWAY}}, framed by it, facing the viewer and waving as they step in over the threshold — the moment of arriving and greeting, seen from within the room they are entering.
Exactly one {{COFFEE}} — a single cup on its saucer, unmistakably ONE, nothing else beside it. The quantity 'one' is the point.
{{MILK}} being poured from the jug into the {{COFFEE}}, the stream of milk clearly visible going into the cup — coffee WITH milk, as opposed to plain black coffee.
A single {{PRICE_TAG}} showing a large question mark '?' — the concept of asking how much it costs (a question, not a fixed price).

{{CUSTOMER}} stepping OUT through the {{DOORWAY}}, facing away with an over-the-shoulder wave — the moment of leaving and saying goodbye. The outward direction (leaving, not entering) is what makes this a farewell.

story.sceneImagePrompt: A single warm establishing scene capturing the essence of ordering coffee at a café: {{CUSTOMER}} at the counter of the {{CAFE}} while {{BARISTA}} serves them, with the {{COFFEE}}, the {{MILK}} jug, and {{EURO_COINS}} all visible on the counter. Full, lived-in {{CAFE}}.
